note: Black Hills NF campground beside Horsethief Lake on SD-244, about 2 mi from Mount Rushmore and 10 mi south of Hill City: paved loops under ponderosa and lodgepole pine above the lake's west shore, with an accessible fishing dock. Only sites 7-18 take RVs and trailers; trailers and motorhomes over 25 ft are barred from the tent area of sites 23-28. Generators 6 a.m.-10 p.m. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API + catalog + FS page: $30 all seasons (2027 rate on sale), no hookups, vault toilets + drinking water, 12 RV sites (007-018) to 45 ft (the stored 25-ft max applies only to the tent area), season mid-April (first-come) to Sept 30, 14-night limit. Closed for the season now (normal). Waterfront: one RV site (017) is ~27-30 m from the lake over open grass - upgrade lead, not applied.
